ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Active'), ISPICKVAL(Ownership__c,'Local Counsel'), NOT( OR( Contingency_Payout_Method__c='Net Paid to National Funding', Contingency_Payout_Method__c='Contingency Paid to Local Counsel' )))
